{
  "domain_entities": [
    {
      "name": "LeaveRequest",
      "attributes": [
        "id: string",

        "reason: string | undefined",
        "status: LeaveRequestStatus",
        "approvedBy: string | null",
        "approvedAt: Date | null",
        "rejectionReason: string | undefined",
        "createdAt: Date",
        "updatedAt: Date"
      ],
      "purpose": "Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through approval/rejection to cancellation. The status field drives all state transitions and guards downstream operations like balance deduction."
    },
    {
      "name": "LeavePolicy",
      "attributes": [
        "id: string",
        "policyName: string",
        "leaveType: string",
        "entitlementDays: number",
        "accrualRate: number | undefined",
        "maxAccumulation: number | undefined",
        "minimumNoticeDays: number",
        "requiresManagerApproval: boolean",
        "isActive: boolean",
        "createdAt: Date",
        "updatedAt: Date"
      ],
      "purpose": "Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Each policy governs how many days an employee is entitled to, whether manager approval is required, minimum notice periods, and accrual behaviour. Policies are referenced by Balance records and LeaveRequests to enforce business rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "Employee",
      "attributes": [
        "id: string",
        "employeeNumber: string",
        "firstName: string",
        "lastName: string",
        "email: string",
        "managerId: string | null",
        "department: string | null",
        "hireDate: Date",
        "terminationDate: Date | null",
        "employmentStatus: string",
        "createdAt: Date",
        "updatedAt: Date",
        "deletedAt: Date | null"
      ],
      "purpose": "Represents an employee in the organisation. Holds employment status, reporting line (managerId), and department. Employment status gates whether the employee can submit leave requests. The managerId defines the approval chain."
    },
    {
      "name": "Balance",
      "attributes": [
        "id: string",
        "employeeId: string",
        "leaveType: string",
        "totalEntitlement: number",
        "usedDays: number",
        "remainingDays: number",
        "fiscalYear: number",
        "status: string",
        "createdAt: Date",
        "updatedAt: Date"
      ],
      "purpose": "Tracks an employee's leave balance for a specific leave type and fiscal year. usedDays is incremented when a leave request is approved; remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays. The status reflects whether the balance has available days."
    },
    {
      "name": "Notification",
      "attributes": [
        "id: string",
        "recipientId: string",
        "type: string",
        "title: string",
        "message: string",
        "relatedEntityType: string | null",
        "relatedEntityId: string | null",
        "status: string",
        "createdAt: Date",
        "readAt: Date | null"
      ],
      "purpose": "Represents a notification sent to an employee or manager about leave-related events (request submitted, approved, rejected, cancelled). Used to fulfil the notification requirement of the leave management module."
